findings.text: follow-on: the manifest cites logs/flaky-note.txt as the evidence that test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py::test_crew_redispatch_keeps_the_harness_behind_a_supervisor[codex] is flaky, but no such file exists in the run's log directory, so the head arm's added failure id is unexplained by any artefact and the done-when's claim of no added failure against base is unverified.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; fe219c5d takes the registry entry and mark inside the guard, 11cdec2c narrows the clearing except to the launch so a recording failure keeps the in-flight mark, fec3cbb8 is the evidence fragment only, and the production change is confined to reckon/crew/resumption.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_resume_claim_spans_its_launch.py plus an importer-population arm and two negative controls; the manifest records 3 passed EXIT=0 in logs/head-arm.log and each control 1 failed/2 passed EXIT=1 in logs/negative-control-a.log and -b.log, but the head importer arm carries one added failure id the base arm does not.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to hold _resume's in-process launch registry entry inside its guarded block until the attempt is recorded or the launch fails; reckon/crew/resumption.py:1101 takes the entry inside the inner try and 1155 discards it in the outer finally after record_resumption at 1148.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; baseline_suite at 7e22391d (3 failed/574 passed) and after_suite at 11cdec2c (2 failed/575 passed) both completed, and it cites logs/flaky-note.txt which is not present on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the run declares reckon/crew/resumption.py, tests/test_a_resume_claim_spans_its_launch.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-writer/a-resume-claim-spans-its-launch.html and a figures dir; git diff --name-only 7e22391d..fec3cbb8 lists exactly the first three.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_resume_claim_spans_its_launch.py:143 fails when the registry take is moved before the guard and :200 fails when the discard is moved before record_resumption, both reproduced by the run's own controls, and :238 fails at the intermediate commit fe219c5d (logs/case3-at-old-head.log).
justifications.evidence: logs/head-arm.log shows 3 passed EXIT=0 and both controls red, but the head importer arm (logs/importers-head.log:404) adds tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py::test_crew_redispatch_keeps_the_harness_behind_a_supervisor[codex] against base and the flaky attribution cites logs/flaky-note.txt which does not exist.
justifications.fit: the change keeps the module's existing registry mechanism and comment idiom (reckon/crew/resumption.py:1092-1097) and adds no name the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/resumption.py:1101 takes the entry inside the inner try and it is discarded only at 1155 after record_resumption at 1148, so a raised mark cannot leak it and a second pass is refused until the attempt is written.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition; it re-places the existing _LAUNCHES_IN_THIS_PROCESS registry (reckon/crew/resumption.py:262) and the existing mark_resume_launching/clear_resume_launching pair, forking no capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 7e22391d..fec3cbb8 lists exactly reckon/crew/resumption.py, tests/test_a_resume_claim_spans_its_launch.py and the fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
